title: fix: IDOR balance mutation via update/RPC
description: updateTransactionAction terima account_id/to_account_id dari client tanpa ownership check, lalu kirim ke RPC apply_transaction_balances yang SECURITY DEFINER + UPDATE accounts tanpa filter user_id. Akibat: user bisa mutate saldo akun user lain. Fix 2 lapis: (1) action layer getAccountById(user.id, newAccountId/newToAccountId) sebelum RPC, (2) RPC tambah p_user_id param + WHERE user_id = p_user_id.
close_reason: 2 lapis: (1) ownership guard getAccountById di updateTransactionAction sebelum RPC, (2) RPC apply_transaction_balances tambah p_user_id + WHERE user_id filter + raise exception kalau 0 rows. Verified live: foreign account_id ditolak. Typecheck clean, 5 tests pass.

title: [security] zod validation di Server Action input (trust boundary)
description: Server Actions (createTransactionAction, updateTransactionAction, createAccountAction, dll) terima input bertipe TS langsung dari client tanpa validasi runtime. TS types dihapus saat compile → client bisa kirim payload arbitrer: amount negatif/NaN, transaction_type di luar enum, transaction_date sampah, string di field number. Akibat: saldo korup, data invalid tembus ke DB. requireUser + account-ownership check sudah ada, tapi field-level validation di trust boundary belum. zod terpasang tapi 0 dipakai (grep bersih).
design: 1 zod schema per action input di src/lib/schemas/ (mis. createTransactionSchema, createAccountSchema). Panggil schema.parse(input) di awal tiap Server Action sebelum sentuh DB. amount: z.number().positive(). transaction_type: z.enum([spending,earning,transfer]). transaction_date: z.string().date(). Reuse schema yang sama utk RHF resolver nanti (dua guna: form + server).
acceptance_criteria: Semua Server Action yang tulis DB validasi input via zod.parse sebelum query. Test: kirim amount negatif → ditolak dgn pesan jelas, bukan saldo korup. Kirim transaction_type invalid → ditolak.
close_reason: zod schemas + safeParse di semua Server Actions; balance mutations atomic via Postgres RPC apply_transaction_balances

title: fix: server-side validation transactions
description: Validasi hanya di form (client), server terima input mentah. Bocor di trust boundary: (1) amount tidak di-guard > 0 di server, (2) transfer ke akun sendiri lolos (account_id === to_account_id), (3) note wajib cuma di form — createTransaction terima null. Fix di createTransactionAction + updateTransactionAction sebelum insert/update: guard amount > 0, reject self-transfer, enforce note non-empty.
acceptance_criteria: Server tolak amount<=0, self-transfer, note kosong dengan pesan jelas. Bypass form (direct action call) tetap ter-reject.
close_reason: semua guards sudah diimplementasi via bf-zrl: amount positive() di zod schema, self-transfer guard eksplisit di createTransactionAction, note min(1) di schema

title: fix: balance-write atomicity di transactions
description: Balance mutations (create/update/delete transaction) = sequential awaits tanpa rollback. updateTransactionAction punya 6 await berurutan (reverse source, reverse dest, apply source, apply dest, update record). Kalau gagal di tengah → balance korup DAN record inkonsisten. Akar: pgBouncer transaction mode (port 6543) blokir BEGIN/SAVEPOINT. Fix: switch ke session mode (port 5432) untuk mutation, atau bungkus di Supabase RPC/Edge Function dengan pg transaction. Impact: data integrity, harus fix sebelum banyak user.
acceptance_criteria: Create/update/delete transaction atomic — gagal di tengah tidak korup balance. Test manual: simulasi error setelah debit, verifikasi credit ter-rollback.
close_reason: zod schemas + safeParse di semua Server Actions; balance mutations atomic via Postgres RPC apply_transaction_balances

title: goal usage ledger: spend-down + history + sub-kategori per goal

Use case: 'Service Kendaraan' tabungan dipakai buat ganti oli/filter/AC, dgn breakdown mobil vs motor. AKUNTANSI KUNCI (anti double-count): pemakaian tabungan kecatat di buku goal, TIDAK di pengeluaran budget bulanan. Budget bulanan = pengeluaran murni dari income. Buku goal = pemakaian tabungan (terpisah). Contoh: income 5jt, expense normal 4jt, pakai dana darurat 2jt -> budget tetap tampil expense 4jt (bukan 6jt), goal collected turun 2jt. IMPLIKASI: collected goal harus bisa TURUN (skrg cuma transfer nambah). Mekanisme: spending/withdraw ber-goal_id kurangi collected. Sub-kategori dalam 1 goal (mobil/motor). Wishlist juga punya detail pemakaian (kapan dipakai, catatan apa). Depends konsep bf-yts transfer 2-field. BRAINSTORM sesi sendiri.
